The best-performing LSTM model combined MRI-derived features with clinical attributes.

40514279.exclusion_reason: DTI tractography study using conventional statistical (AUC) prognostic analysis; no AI/ML model

40528527.model_description: A diffusion probabilistic generative model reconstructs high-quality neonatal brain MR images from undersampled k-space data, trained on low-SNR, low-quantity real-world 1T NICU MRI data using self-supervised denoising and posterior-sample averaging, to shorten scan time while maintaining diagnostic quality.

40561751.model_family: causal discovery analysis (CDA), a machine learning algorithm
40561751.clinical_problem: identifying neural and environmental factors causally related to psychosis proneness in youth

40561751.model_description: Working-memory fMRI activation is combined with sociodemographic, environmental, cognitive, and self-schema variables (37 variables total) and analyzed with causal discovery analysis, a machine-learning algorithm, to infer directional causal relationships underlying psychosis proneness.

40582483.patient_population: children after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, imaged within 24 hours
40582483.model_description: Deep learning models are trained on early head CT images to discriminate scans from children after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest from age-matched controls, to predict death and unfavorable neurologic outcome, and to identify hypoxic-ischemic brain injury not visually apparent to a radiologist.

40582896.model_family: three-stage deep learning framework (CNN-based) with Grad-CAM explainability
40582896.clinical_problem: noninvasive screening for infant meningitis, reducing need for lumbar puncture
40582896.patient_population: 30 infants with suspected meningitis and a permeable fontanelle at three Spanish university hospitals
40582896.model_description: High-resolution transfontanelle ultrasound images (Neosonics technology) are processed through a three-stage deep learning pipeline: quality control/vessel identification, classification of images as meningitis or control based on a white-blood-cell-count threshold, and Grad-CAM-based explainable AI visualization to support interpretability.
40582896.dataset_size: 30 infants (16 evaluable: 6 meningitis cases, 10 controls); 781 images in stage 2

40587357.clinical_problem: fetal ultrasound image segmentation for fetal development assessment and intrauterine surgery planning
40587357.model_description: A semi-supervised segmentation method uses prototypes generated from labeled fetal ultrasound images to create pseudo-labels for unlabeled images, and pseudo-prototypes to segment the labeled data inversely, achieving bidirectional consistency; uncertainty-based cross-supervision further refines pseudo-label quality, reducing the need for large annotated datasets.
40587357.dataset_size: two fetal ultrasound datasets (plus two general medical segmentation datasets for generalization testing)

40614758.model_family: ResNet-18 + Mamba Vision (state-space model) dual-branch CNN with self-attention fusion

40614758.dataset_size: two publicly available chest x-ray datasets (a pediatric pneumonia dataset, and a multi-source pneumonia/COVID-19/normal dataset)

40660927.model_family: vision transformer with sparse-coding network head, self-supervised

40660927.model_description: A modified 3D Vision Transformer, trained self-supervised on pediatric cardiac photon-counting CT data with variable noise levels, denoises images by dynamically balancing data fidelity against sparse dictionary representation to match local noise estimates, aiming to preserve coronary, valve, and ventricular anatomy relevant to congenital heart defect diagnosis.

40661653.clinical_problem: active case-finding for tuberculosis using portable digital chest x-ray with computer-aided detection
